reason: GPU power limits are off: the graphics driver crashed (exit code 0xC0000005). They are tried again after Windows restarts or the graphics driver is updated.

problem.title: The graphics driver crashed
problem.message: RIGStats asked the graphics driver for its power limit and the driver crashed. Sensors, fans and lighting keep working — only the GPU power limit is off. This usually happens after Windows Update replaced the graphics driver: install the latest driver, then restart Windows. RIGStats tries again after a restart or a driver update.
